newsitem.title: USA: LTV's profits fall by a third to $29.4 million.
newsitem.headline: LTV's profits fall by a third to $29.4 million.

text.p: LTV Corp. said Friday its profits fell by almost a third in the latest quarter as it tried to cope with lower prices for its steel products and increased expenses, including higher wages.
The company said its net income for the three months ended Sept. 30 fell by 32 percent to $29.4 million, or 27 cents a share, from $43.2 million, or 40 cents a share, primarily due to lower prices.

LTV said its sales in the quarter, a normally slow period, increased by 1 percent to $1.049 billion from $1.04 billion on higher shipment levels, which were partially offset by lower average selling prices.
The company said higher shipment levels by its flat rolled division and cost containment measures helped to offset lower prices and higher wage costs.

LTV said its net income for the first nine months of the year plunged to $74.7 million, or 69 cents a share, from $150.0 million, or $1.38 a share, as sales shrunk 4 percent to $3.12 billion from $3.24 billion.
The company said the drop in sales was due to lower average selling prices, which were only partially offset by higher shipment volumes.
LTV's stock was unchanged at $10.25 in midday trading on the New York Stock Exchange.
